name: Michelangelo Buonarroti
summary: Innovative and detail-oriented UI-UX Designer with over 5 years of experience in creating user-friendly and engaging web designs. Proven ability to understand user needs and translate them into functional and appealing digital experiences.

description: Lead design projects from conception to completion for various clients.
Conduct user research and usability testing to inform design decisions.
Collaborate with developers to ensure designs are implemented correctly.
Designed user interfaces for web and mobile applications.
Worked closely with cross-functional teams to create cohesive user experiences.
Created wireframes and prototypes to communicate design concepts.
Assisted in designing user interfaces for various projects.
Participated in user research sessions and analyzed feedback.
Helped maintain design system and documentation.

extra_info.title: Projects
items: Redesigned the user interface for a leading e-commerce platform resulting in a 30% increase in user engagement.
Developed a mobile app prototype that was selected for funding at a tech startup pitch event.
